impact.text: creating a permanent lock on any yield that accumulated since `lastCalculatedTimestamp_` and any yield that accumulates after the reward distribution period ends

precondition_sources.text: lastCalculatedTimestamp_ is before maxEndTime (e.g. lastCalculatedTimestamp_ == maxEndTime - 100).
getPeriodRewards(rewardPoolIndex_, lastCalculatedTimestamp_, maxEndTime) returns zero for the period.
Yield of 10e18 accumulated during that time (yield == 10e18).

intent_sources.text: Yield accumulated for a deposit pool must remain withdrawable even when no rewards accrue for the period (including after maxEndTime).
lastUnderlyingBalance must be updated to reflect the current token balance including accumulated yield independently of reward calculations.
